Sushizanmai is a nationally famous sushi chain. Tuna is their specialty, and they carefully select the most delicious tuna from around the world each season. Sushi starts from an affordable ¥140 per piece, and they offer a wide variety of options, including tuna tasting sets, sashimi, and seafood bowls. They have great lunch sets for around ¥1,000 on weekdays from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM and are open late until 6:00 AM, making it easy to fit into your travel plans. - Shin-Okubo (near Shinjuku): Uobei Shin-Okubo [...] On the other hand, regular conveyor belt sushi restaurants must discard sushi that has been on the belt for too long. Uobei, however, doesn't face this issue, allowing them to offer high-quality, cost-effective options to customers.

At Uobei, a plate of sushi dishes typically ranges from 110 yen to 160 yen, with a diverse menu selection. They use a slightly sweet soy sauce, and their wasabi is delicious, enhancing the flavor of the sashimi even further.
